summary: This Dockerfile creates a lightweight Python container optimized for running a FastAPI web application. It starts with a slim Python image, installs FastAPI, copies your application code into the container, and configures it to run a Uvicorn web server with auto-reload enabled so changes take effect immediately.

explanations.2: The 'slim' variant is a smaller version of the official Python image that includes just enough to run Python—it cuts out extra tools and libraries you probably won't need, making your final container smaller.
explanations.8: The --no-cache-dir flag tells pip not to store downloaded package files locally in the container, which saves space since we don't need them after installation is complete.
explanations.15: The --reload flag makes Uvicorn automatically restart whenever main.py changes, which is helpful during development; --host 0.0.0.0 makes the server accessible from outside the container, and --port 82 runs it on port 82 instead of the default 8000.
